summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Draw Configuration system with 5 tabs, 4 entry calculation methods, bonus multipliers, entry caps, and frontend-only save functionality. All core features working perfectly.
passed_tests: ✅ Draw setup page loads correctly at /draw-setup
✅ All 5 tabs navigation working: Basic Info, Entry Rules, Bonuses, Limits & Caps, Preview & Test
✅ Basic Info tab: Draw name input, country selector (Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda), draw type selector, prize pool configuration
✅ Entry Rules tab: All 4 calculation methods working (Fixed, Amount-Based, Tiered, VAT-Based) with method-specific configuration panels
✅ Bonuses tab: All bonus types present (First Scan, Weekend, Streak, Merchant Category) with multiplier configuration working
✅ Limits & Caps tab: Per Receipt/Day/Week caps with +/- controls, Advanced Settings (minimum amount, verified merchant toggle, validity period)
✅ Preview & Test tab: Real-time entry calculation with test amount input, shows applied bonuses and breakdown
✅ Save functionality: Save modal appears with success message, shows correct configuration details
✅ Dynamic calculations: Entry results update correctly when switching between methods and adjusting settings
✅ Bonus multipliers: 37+ multiplier options found, 3x selection working, applied bonuses showing in calculations
✅ Merchant categories: All 5 categories present (Groceries, Electronics, Fuel, Healthcare, Education)
✅ Interactive controls: +/- buttons for caps, switches for toggles, all clickable elements responding correctly
